guardrails: Fish River/Weeks Bay is a regional proxy and must never be labeled local Fairhope or Point Clear bottom DO.

NOAA CO-OPS station 8733821 was removed on 2011-02-05; present-day output is astronomical tide prediction only and must never be labeled LIVE/OBSERVED or used for sensor health, observed water-level tendency, or surge residual.
NOAA CO-OPS 8735180 observed Dauphin Island water level and NGOFS2 MODEL guidance are separate sources at their actual locations; neither inherits Point Clear identity.

GCOOS DISL_BSPA and DISL_MHPA dissolved oxygen remain DEPTH_UNKNOWN_OBSERVATION_PROXY: their depth coordinate is constant 0.0 m and their ug/L metadata conflicts with native DISL mg/L definitions; do not auto-convert or use for BOTTOM_DO, vertical gradients, or stratification until reconciled.
Predicted tide, observed water level, water-level tendency, and modeled current direction are separate fields.
Missing or stale inputs widen uncertainty and are never carried forward as current observations.
